title: 第23章 何人擅闯我烟霞峰地界第24章 是我惹不起的大佬
slug: 师妹别脑补了师兄真的是凡人
content_zh:
次日。
清晨的阳光洒在烟霞峰小院。
陆鸣提着木桶，慢悠悠地给菜地浇水，目光时不时瞟向摇椅上闭目修炼的林清瑶。
这妮子倒也是勤勉，距离上次玄辉真人来过后的这两天。
每天早上她和陆鸣做完广播体操后就去喂鸡。
喂完鸡后就会来到摇椅上一刻不停的修炼直到夜里。
七脉大比将近，林清瑶的修为也在缓步增长。
但光有修为就行了吗？
陆鸣虽然没修炼过，但前世看过不少小说。
知道修士之间比试，很多时候拼的不光是纸面实力，还有战斗意识与应变能力这些虚头巴脑的东西。
更何况，那些小说之中越级击败对手的事情也是常事。
陆鸣有些忐忑。
这丫头……整天不是打坐就是喂鸡，除了上次被那条妖蛇花式虐了无数遍，实战经验基本为零吧？
到时候别上了擂台，别被人一套王八拳就给揍下来了。
要是拿不到好名次，就获得不了修炼资源。
没有修炼资源提升修为的速度就会变慢。
修为提升速度变慢，那我的领域增加速度就会变慢。
不行，得确保万无一失！
绝不能让我的领域增加速度变慢。
陆鸣越想越觉得这是个隐患。

于是放下水瓢，走到林清瑶旁边：“师妹。”
林清瑶缓缓收功，睁开眼：“师兄，有何吩咐？”
“嗯……”
陆鸣组织了一下语言，问道：“你对于七脉大比，可有十足把握进入前十？”
林清瑶闻言，认真思索片刻，回答道：
“回师兄，前几日清瑶修为提升过快，道基略有虚浮，这几日借助功法与新得资源，已稳固许多。
至于大比……”
说到这里，她顿了顿，似乎自己心里也没底：
“清瑶虽有心争胜，但具体如何较量，心中并无太多概念，只知需尽力而为。”
果然没有把握！
陆鸣心里嘀咕一声，有些着急。
不行，必须得让她拿个前十回来。
那样她才能获得修炼资源。
但想归想，陆鸣也不知道具体从哪里入手，于是问道：
“那你以为，修士之间比试较量，何种因素最为重要？”
身为修士的林清瑶很清楚这个问题，立刻回答道：
“依清瑶浅见，首要自然是修为境界，灵力雄厚者自是占优。”
content_en:
The next day.
The early morning sunshine shines on the Yanxiafeng courtyard.
Lu Ming carried a wooden bucket and slowly watered the vegetable field. From time to time, he glanced at Lin Qingyao who was practicing in the rocking chair with his eyes closed.
This girl is quite diligent. It has been two days since the last time Master Xuanhui came.
Every morning after she and Lu Ming finished doing radio gymnastics, they went to feed the chickens.
After feeding the chickens, he would sit on the rocking chair and practice non-stop until night.
The Seven Meridian Competition is approaching, and Lin Qingyao's cultivation is also slowly increasing.
But is it enough to just have cultivation skills?
Although Lu Ming has never practiced cultivation, he has read many novels in his previous life.
I know that when monks compete with each other, they often compete not only on paper strength, but also on such frivolous things as combat consciousness and adaptability.
What's more, it's common in those novels to defeat opponents by leapfrogging.
Lu Ming was a little uneasy.
This girl... spends her whole day either meditating or feeding chickens. Except for being tortured countless times by that demonic snake last time, she has basically zero actual combat experience, right?
Don't get in the ring then, don't be beaten down by someone with a set of bastard punches.
If you don't get a good ranking, you won't be able to obtain training resources.
Without cultivation resources, the speed of improving one's cultivation level will become slower.
If the speed of improvement of my cultivation level slows down, then the speed of increase of my domain will also slow down.
No, we have to make sure that nothing goes wrong!
There's no way I'm going to let my domain increase any slower.
The more Lu Ming thought about it, the more he felt that this was a hidden danger.
So he put down the water ladle and walked to Lin Qingyao: "Junior sister."
Lin Qingyao slowly stopped her power and opened her eyes: "Senior brother, what are your orders?"
"Well..."
Lu Ming organized his speech and asked: "Are you absolutely sure that you will enter the top ten in the Seven Meridians Competition?"
Hearing this, Lin Qingyao thought seriously for a moment and replied:
"Back to senior brother, Qingyao's cultivation level improved too quickly in the past few days, and his Taoist foundation was a little shaky. In the past few days, with the help of his skills and new resources, he has become much more stable.
As for Dabi..."
At this point, she paused, as if she didn't know what she was thinking:
"Although Qingyao is determined to win, she doesn't have much idea of how to compete specifically. She just knows that she needs to do her best."
Sure enough, I’m not sure!
Lu Ming muttered in his heart, feeling a little anxious.
No, she must come back with a top ten finish.
Only in this way can she obtain training resources.
But after thinking about it, Lu Ming didn't know where to start, so he asked:
"Then what do you think is the most important factor in a competition between monks?"
As a monk, Lin Qingyao knew this question very well and immediately answered:
"According to Qingyao's humble opinion, the first priority is to cultivate the realm, and those with strong spiritual power will have the upper hand."
